extensionDescription.message: Import and export your bookmarks easily

welcomeDescription.message: Easily import and export your bookmarks across browsers!

gettingStarted.message: To get started, click on the extension icon in your browser toolbar.

exportToJSONDescription.message: Export your bookmarks to JSON format for easy data manipulation and backup.

exportToHTMLDescription.message: Export your bookmarks to HTML format for easy data manipulation and backup.

importBookmarksDescription.message: Easily import bookmarks from JSON or HTML files to restore or transfer your data.

advancedOptionsDescription.message: Fine-tune your exports with advanced settings and selective bookmark choosing.

compatibleBrowsers.message: Compatible with all Chromium-based browsers, including Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, Opera, and Brave.

feedbackLink.message: Enjoying the extension? We'd love your feedback!

autoExpandFoldersDescription.message: Automatically expand folders in the bookmark tree

autoExpandFoldersTooltip.message: Note: May impact performance with large numbers of bookmarks

includeIconDataDescription.message: Add website favicon data to the exported file

includeIconDataTooltip.message: Note: Increases export time and file size significantly

includeDateAddedDescription.message: Add creation dates to the exported file

includeDateLastUsedDescription.message: Add last used dates to the exported file

includeDateGroupModifiedDescription.message: Add last modification dates for folders to the exported file

includeDateGroupModifiedTooltip.message: Note: Only available for HTML and JSON exports. Not applicable for CSV exports as they only include individual bookmarks.

hideOtherBookmarksDescription.message: Exclude the root 'Other bookmarks' folder from the export

hideOtherBookmarksTooltip.message: Note: Matches browser's native export behavior, placing 'Other bookmarks' content at the same level as 'Bookmarks bar'

hideParentFolderDescription.message: Exclude parent folders from the exported file

hideParentFolderTooltip.message: Note: Excludes parent folders from the exported file

changelog_1_1_0_1.message: Imported bookmarks now go to their own folder to avoid mixing with your existing bookmarks

changelog_1_1_0_2.message: More precise control over which dates to include in your exports

changelog_1_0_0_1.message: Added new Advanced Export feature for more control over your bookmarks.

changelog_1_0_0_2.message: Introduced welcome and update pages to keep you informed about new features.

changelog_1_0_0_3.message: Improved overall performance for a smoother experience.

changelog_0_1_1_1.message: Fixed a critical bug that affected users with non-English browser languages.

changelog_0_1_1_2.message: Improved reliability for both import and export functions.

changelog_0_1_1_3.message: Fixed an issue where the extension icon was not showing in the browser toolbar.

changelog_0_1_1_4.message: Fixed an issue where the extension was not working in some browsers.

changelog_0_1_0_1.message: Initial release of Bookmark Import/Export extension.

changelog_0_1_0_2.message: Simple import feature for HTML and JSON files.

changelog_0_1_0_3.message: Basic functionality for exporting bookmarks to HTML and JSON formats.

exportToCSVDescription.message: Export your bookmarks to CSV format for easy data manipulation and backup.

multiLanguageSupportDescription.message: Automatically adapts to your browser's language! Available in English and Spanish.

changelog_1_3_0_1.message: Added dark mode support that automatically matches your system theme preferences.
